text:
violet (oncall): FYI apiserver 502s and etcd leader stuck in follower-sync state in us-west-2 after a scheduled AZ network maint. GPU onboarding pods now Pending. anyone aware? :confused:

chao: saw a spike in etcd fsync latency right after the maint window. leader stayed but stopped applying commits fast. watch reconnects everywhere.

eng-infra: cloud reported a short control-plane network flap during the maint and some storage IO reattachments. they increased IOPS and bumped SNAT ephemeral ports for the region.

violet (oncall): can we route read-heavy watchers to read-only follower endpoints for now? also any quick controller throttles we can flip?

chao: i can patch kube-controller-manager to reduce concurrency and extend sync period:
```bash
kubectl -n kube-system patch deploy kube-controller-manager --patch '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"containers":[{"name":"kube-controller-manager","args":["--concurrent-deployment-syncs=1","--concurrent-job-syncs=0","--controller-sync-period=120s"]}]}}}}'
```

zeus-bot: alert: etcd_commit_latency > 350ms (us-west-2) — ticket INC-7721 created.

eng-infra: spun up a small relaxed-taint GPU nodepool in us-west-2b to help drain pending pods. also cordoned two noisy CI nodes. scheduling picked up ~30% in 8m.

chao: temporarily disabled large snapshot uploads from onboard pipeline and asked the pipeline team to stagger artifact uploads.

violet (oncall): monitoring: apiserver errors down 60%, etcd commit latency trending down to ~180ms. keep incident open for 20m. follow-ups: (1) add runbook step for AZ maintenance gating on control-plane IO, (2) permanent SNAT capacity increase for us-west-2, (3) evaluate follower-read endpoints and watcher backoff defaults.

eng-infra: noted. opening RFC for SNAT/IOPS budget changes and a pre-maint checklist to cordon noisy workloads before AZ work.

violet (oncall): thanks all. closing if stable in 20m. :thumbsup:
